# skycloak_openfga_instance (Data Source)

Look up an existing OpenFGA instance on a cluster, by instance ID or by the realm it is bound to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an instance by the realm it is bound to...
data "skycloak_openfga_instance" "orders" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm      = "orders"
}

# ...or by its ID.
data "skycloak_openfga_instance" "by_id" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  id         = "7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Instance ID (UUID). Set either `id` or `realm`.
- `realm` (String) Realm the instance is bound to. Set either `id` or `realm`.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) Where the instance's OpenFGA API answers.
- `audience` (String) The audience a token must carry.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer the instance trusts.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `provisioning`, `ready`, `failed` or `deleting`.
- `status_message` (String) The reason the instance is `failed`; empty otherwise.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
